overall_goal: Wash dishes and clean the kitchen counter

goals.description: Wash the lid and glass in the sink
goals.rationale: The person turns on the tap, washes a lid and a glass, places items in the drying tray, and turns off the water.

goals.description: Wipe the tabletop and clear away trash
goals.rationale: The person uses a cloth to dry their hands, wipes down the counter while moving items out of the way, collects trash to put in the sink, and hangs up the cloth.
